Careers at Cynomi

Feel The Impact of Doing Work That Matters.

“Built to Scale Your Business, So You Can Protect Every Client.” That’s our promise to partners, and the reason this team exists. Cynomi is the Security Growth Platform for MSPs, MSSPs, and vCISO cyber advisory firms, powered by CISO Intelligence. If you want your work to show up in how every business gets protected, you’re in the right place.

What Cynomi is All About

We live by five values, the same ones that guide partner engagements, product decisions and board presentations. Here’s what they look like day to day.

  1. 01
    Own It End to End

    Full accountability from start to finish, no excuses, no handoffs of blame.

  2. 02
    Innovate With Purpose

    Ideas earn their place by creating real, measurable value, not by generating activity.

  3. 03
    Be Bold, Stay Humble

    The courage to challenge how things are done, paired with the humility to listen and change your mind.

  4. 04
    Collaborate & Elevate

    Be a force multiplier, actively make the people around you better, not just your own output.

  5. 05
    Be Transparent, Build Trust

    Communicate proactively and share the “why,” so trust is built before it’s ever tested.

What Our Team Loves About Cynomi

Here’s how our team describes living those values day to day.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Cynomi’s mission?

Cynomi’s mission is to equip every business with CISO-level security through scalable partner delivery. Cynomi is 100% channel driven, partnering exclusively with MSPs, MSSPs, and vCISO cyber advisory firms – so every client, at every maturity level, can get that protection.

What is the company culture like at Cynomi?

Cynomi operates by five values: Own It End to End, Innovate With Purpose, Be Bold Stay Humble, Collaborate & Elevate, and Be Transparent Build Trust. In practice, that means no micromanagement, real trust across a global team, and open communication from first week to leadership.

What is Cynomi?

Cynomi is the Security Growth Platform for service providers: MSPs, MSSPs, and vCISO cyber advisory firms, powered by CISO Intelligence: the decision-making logic of an experienced security leader, built into every workflow. It replaces manual, one-off security work with guided, repeatable programs, so any team member can deliver CISO-level outcomes.

Who does Cynomi help?

Cynomi is built exclusively for service providers: MSPs, MSSPs, IT and vCISO consultancies, telcos, and cyber advisory practices, not for their end customers directly. Cynomi is 100% channel, with no direct sales motion competing with partners. Through those partners, Cynomi ultimately helps SMBs and mid-market businesses, at every maturity level, get CISO-level protection they couldn’t otherwise access or afford.

What makes Cynomi different from other GRC or vCISO platforms?

Most compliance tools track checkboxes for auditors. Cynomi manages the entire security program – assessment, prioritization, execution, and improvement, and layers in portfolio-level revenue insights so partners can see where new services and recurring revenue are hiding across their client base. It’s purpose-built for how service providers operate, not adapted from an enterprise or audit-first tool.

How is Cynomi funded, and what stage is the company at?

Cynomi was founded in 2021 and is backed by investors including Canaan Partners, Insight Partners, Flint Capital, S16VC, and Entrée Capital. The company closed a $37M Series B round in 2025, following a $20M Series A in 2024, and has grown from its original Israel and UK base to expand across North America, throughout EMEA and into APAC. Our new US Headquarters is based in Orlando, Florida.

What are Cynomi’s company values?

Cynomi’s values drive how we operate, collaborate and engage with each other, and our partners day in and day out.
